## About
Fleet Painting & Body Shop is a paint and body shop on W Sherman St in Phoenix. We perform all stages of paint and bodywork, from rock chips to major collisions, on small trucks to semi trucks, trailers, vans, RVs and busses, and miscellaneous equipment.
The facility is recognized as a Sherwin-Williams Commercial Fleet Refinisher. Dave Lienweber is president, and reviewers thank Dave, James and Mark by name. Rated 4.5 from 20 Google reviews.

## Services
- Collisions: Major collision or rock chips in your paint. We perform all major to minor collision work and get your vehicle back to pre-accident condition.
- Day cab conversions: Thinking about getting off the road? We convert conventional OTR trucks to multi-use day cabs. We remove the sleeper, fabricate panels and move exhaust equipment. Working with K & H manufacturing, we turned an OTR sleeper cab into a dump truck.
- Sandblasting: Strip it down before fresh paint.
- Aluminum Welding: Welding on aluminum parts and bodies.
- Frame Straightening: Frame work as part of collision repair.
- Single & Multi Color Stripes: Single color or multi color stripes on your truck.
- Fender to Full Paint jobs: One fender or the whole vehicle.

## FAQ
Q: Will you work with my insurance company?
A: Yes. We work with your insurance company to get your vehicle back to pre-accident condition.

Q: What vehicles do you work on?
A: Small trucks to semi trucks, trailers, vans, RVs and busses, and miscellaneous equipment.

Q: Can you take the sleeper off my OTR truck?
A: Yes. We remove the sleeper, fabricate panels and move exhaust equipment to make it a multi-use day cab.

Q: What are your hours?
A: Monday to Friday, 7:00 AM to 3:00 PM. Closed Saturday and Sunday.
